svg.title: Journey 1 · End-to-End Capture, Parallel Progress, Failure Recovery & Success (Era 3)
svg.desc: End-to-end journey map for Journey 1: pure /capture entry feeding a server-backed Home progress bar supporting parallel imports, honest Searchable vs. Still enriching stages, full capture failure recovery across Photo, PDF, Link, and Description (goto-synthesis), enrichment-only failure recovery, and multi-device sync with zero global toast or banner interruptions.
svg.text: WFS / Shared Table · Family Cookbook Era 3 · Journey 1 (OpenSpec: capture-activity-and-recovery)
Capture, Parallel Progress, Failure Recovery & Success Journeys
/capture stays pure & fast; Home displays live parallel progress bars; Searchable precedes Still enriching; every capture error recovers cleanly.

g.text: Flow 1 · Pure /capture → Parallel Progress on Home → Honest Success
Supports 1 or N parallel imports · Hydrated via GET /api/captures/activity + SSE
• Submit multiple recipes in a row
Zero tabs, drawers, or menus in /capture
• 1 item: Recipe name, step & progress bar
Flow 2 · Failed Capture Recovery (Photo, PDF, Link & Description)
Includes goto-synthesis · Zero DB or disk leftovers when unready stub is cleared
Recipe stays cookable & keyword-searchable · Never offers destructive Clear
Tap card to open recipe; Trash is intentionally
omitted so saved recipes stay protected.
Survives reload, closed tab, or partner’s phone · Shared recovery contract
• Page reloads, or Phone B opens app
• No floating popups break focus mid-task
Return to /home when ready to check progress
• Capture Activity Sheet (1 tap from Home)
Both mount the exact same failure-row
Same behavior, same confirmation, zero drift
• Either partner can retry or clear
